newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thief caught hiding in Bangkok police station loo.
newsitem.headline: Thief caught hiding in Bangkok police station loo.

text.p: A Thai thief has learned the hard way that appearances can be deceiving.

Suriya Umphuphorn took refuge in the toilet of a Bangkok police station after snatching a purse on the street on Tuesday, mistaking its Thai-style roof for that of a Buddhist temple, police said on Wednesday.
Police stormed the restroom and arrested Suriya, 22, after his prolonged occupation of the room aroused their suspicion.
Suriya told police that he was from a poor northeastern province and had arrived in the capital to look for a job. He said he stole the purse from a woman when he ran out of money.
Suriya is being detained on charges of robbery pending a formal trial, police said.
